descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
该API主要用于管理和配置与钉钉等即时通讯工具集成的聊天机器人设置，包括但不限于创建新的聊天配置、更新现有配置、获取特定配置详情以及删除不再需要的配置。通过此API，可以实现对不同用户或用户组权限的精细化控制，并能够指定具体的RAM角色来执行相关操作。此外，还支持为每个配置添加标签以便于管理和分类。

特别注意的是，在调用此API时，需确保提供的`RegionId`、`ConversationId`以及请求体中的各项参数准确无误，尤其是涉及到安全敏感信息如`ClientId`、`ClientSecret`等字段时更应谨慎处理，避免泄露给非授权方。
descriptions.en:
## Description

This API manages chatbot settings for integrations with instant messaging tools, such as DingTalk. Operations include creating new chat configurations, updating existing ones, retrieving configuration details, and deleting configurations. This API lets you implement fine-grained permission control for different users or user groups and specify a Resource Access Management (RAM) role to execute operations. You can also add tags to each configuration for management and classification.

When you call this API, ensure that the `RegionId`, `ConversationId`, and all parameters in the request body are correct. Handle sensitive information, such as the `ClientId` and `ClientSecret` fields, with care to prevent disclosure to unauthorized parties.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-chat-configuration --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name Ginlong-AIops --type DingTalk --ram-role AliyunOOSLifecycleHook4CSRole --configuration DingTalkTemplateId_:_template-123_,_DingTalkClientId_:_client-123_,_DingTalkClientSecret_:_secret-123 --resource-group-id rg-2cd300009dc2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateChatConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --Type DingTalk --Configuration 'DingTalkTemplateId_:_template-123_,_DingTalkClientId_:_client-123_,_DingTalkClientSecret_:_secret-123' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-2cd300009dc2' --RamRole AliyunOOSLifecycleHook4CSRole --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name 'Ginlong-AIops'
